repository_observation.preservation: The four intervening main commits and both main-only paths are preserved; only nine append-only research artifacts are transplanted.

key_reconciliations.finding: SBI Shinsei Trust Bank is the JPYSC issuer; SBI VC Trade is distributor and lending counterparty; Startale Group is development partner. SBI's >JPY30B handled balance is on-chain balance plus lending balance, while >JPY10B is lending balance.
key_reconciliations.non_inference: Not public-chain supply, external settlement, XRP collateral, XRP purchases or net XRP capital inflow. Customers lend JPYSC to SBI VC Trade; they are not borrowing against collateral.

key_reconciliations.finding: SBI's Ripple relationship, Circle SBI Japan 50/50 JV, JPYSC program, October 27 tokenized-MMF/JPYSC MOU with BlackRock entities and October 30 stablecoin alliance with SMFG are separate graph edges.
key_reconciliations.non_inference: No verified JPYSC deployment on XRPL, Circle Arc or StableFX in the captured evidence; Tokyo SBIC is a different legal entity.

key_reconciliations.finding: The 233.45492M XRP redistribution is an XRPL event with six recipients; the reported Tron laundering stream is a separate chain and flow. The two 40M XRP payments are components of the 233.45492M total, not an additional 80M.
key_reconciliations.non_inference: No sale, exchange deposit or conversion of the six recipients' XRP is established; recipient balances still require pinned-ledger refresh.

key_reconciliations.finding: Issuer freeze events are chain- and address-specific. The OnChain Benchmark timeline explicitly did not read XRPL; its Ethereum/Tron/other-chain totals cannot verify the XRPL XRP tranche or XRPL RLUSD balances.
key_reconciliations.non_inference: Frozen is not recovered or returned; cross-provider totals must not be added without address-level de-duplication.

key_reconciliations.finding: Separate transaction count, gross payment value, net external settlement, issuer mint/redemption, pooled exchange custody, collateral, wrapped supply, ETF holdings, lending balances and tokenized registry notional.
key_reconciliations.non_inference: Do not use x402 transaction count, RWA registry notional, handled balances or exchange wallet totals as direct XRP demand.

key_reconciliations.finding: The exact requested identity Camilla Stephenson remains unresolved. Dr Kamilah/Camila/Camilla Stevenson is a separate candidate; the seven video IDs are a candidate catalog, not an exhaustive inventory attributed to Camilla Stephenson.
key_reconciliations.non_inference: Do not merge identities or attribute videos to the exact requested person without confirmation.

Provider price, OI, volume and depth observations have non-synchronized timestamps and venue coverage; do not average.
Circle/Tether freeze amounts require address-level and time-window reconciliation; no sum is admitted.
XRPL recipient account balances and transaction histories require a fresh pinned-ledger RPC/Clio read.
The exact Camilla Stephenson identity and exhaustive YouTube inventory remain unresolved.

platform_coordination.rule: No platform is represented as collaborating live without an independently tested authenticated handoff.

feature_admission.jpysc_lending_balance: Centralized customer-to-exchange lending stock; not DeFi borrowing or XRP collateral.
feature_admission.cbxrp_supply: Wrapped custody claim; do not add to native XRP supply.
feature_admission.exchange_wallet_balances: Custody/attribution series only; not tradable float.

feature_admission.freeze_events: Address/chain/time-scoped event features only after de-duplication.
feature_admission.market_quotes: Require synchronized venue timestamps and coverage metadata.
